evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes the escaped instance string for both %i and %I. systemd defines %I as the unescaped instance name, so for ingress@crq\x2dtick.socket a Service=%I.service reference becomes crq\x2dtick.service instead of crq-tick.service and the dependency scan misses the target. This is an implementation error in the intended expansion, not a new requirement; unescape only the %I replacement.
